name: Evergrove
long_description:
We've built voice agents for the largest work comp managed care orgs and specialist PT networks in the country, making >500K calls annually and accelerating the speed at which they coordinate care. On average, our customers see a 40% increase in workflow completion, 10x decrease in cycle times, and >60% reduction in cost.

We think voice agents are the starting point for solving slow and fragmented care coordination in this market. Companies that manage an injured worker's care rely on short-staffed contact centres and archaic methods of info exchange: phone, fax, and email. Every delay along the path of care leads to slower rehab of the injured worker, lower throughput for providers, and higher expense for the insurer/employer.
one_liner: Instant healthcare for all, starting with work comp

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
Co-founder and CEO. We're building interoperability in healthcare and commercial insurance. Voice agents are our bread & butter. Prev AI PM lead at Newfront (Acq for $1.3B), Azure ML & VS Code at MSFT, Waterloo Eng Alum (2018), and co-founder of appinkflow.com (bootstrapped).

Co-founder and I built AI-native placement service within Newfront. Small team of expert humans and agent swarms negotiated policies between $300K and $1M USD, achieving 40% faster renewal times, and 15-20% cost reduction.

founders.title: Founder/CTO
founders.founder_bio:
Co-founder and CTO. We build agents for healthcare enterprises. Prev AI engineer at Newfront (Acq for $1.3B). Was on the platform team, wrote code for millions of authentication and authorization interactions at Newfront; Refactored file management for millions of mission critical insurance files.

launches.title: Evergrove: Interoperability for work comp
launches.tagline: Voice agents that accelerate post-claim care
launches.body:
We’re keeping this short and sweet. We build voice agents to overcome slow and fragmented care coordination in workers’ comp. Some key points:

1. We’re on track to make >500K calls annually, helping customers get to >60% reduction in cost and 40%+ improvement in workflow completion.
2. Our customers are some of the largest managed care orgs, specialty networks, and ancillary service providers in the work comp space.
3. We’re ex-Newfront, where we pioneered agents that were cited in the $1.3B acquisition [press release](https://www.wtwco.com/en-us/news/2025/12/wtw-to-acquire-newfront-a-specialized-broker-combining-deep-expertise-and-cutting-edge-technology). We’ve spent our careers inside commercial insurance.

Our mission is to have Evergrove agents powering comms between **every** entity on the post-claim care pathway. If you want to learn more about how we’re seeing early network effects, reach out at [sid@evergrovelabs.com](mailto:sid@evergrovelabs.com).

_“If I had more time I would have written a shorter \[launch post\]”_
